# Private Windows DLL build

Prerequisites: Zig 0.16.0, Python3, make; no Mac libffi or Microsoft lib.exe. Official libffi 3.5.2 full source and tarball are in deps/. Fixed source is already frozen and all hashes are recorded.

1. `python3 build-libffi.py` constructs both COFF archives from the official source (per command timeout55s). GNU ARM cache-flush builtin is satisfied by the included `deps/arm-clear-cache.c`, using FlushInstructionCache and abort on failure. It is not a stub.
2. `FFI_PREFIX_BASE="$PWD/deps/rebuilt" python3 build-dll.py` constructs two DLLs from frozen formal libunisacc.c and Windows bridges using the corresponding headers/archive. Each compile/link is bounded55s.
3. Inspect the exact rc/command/time receipts and logs. Both commands were actually run, with all rc0. Both compile logs are empty, and each DLL exports17 API names.

This establishes compile/link only. No Windows native execution, resolver support, guest mmap support or ARM SEH support is claimed. ARM official GNU sysv.S COFF lacks Windows unwind; official MSVC ARMASM route remains the production alternative for that obligation.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json,shutil,time
D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
R=D/'deps/rebuilt';R.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
receipts=[]
def run(name,cmd,cwd=None,env=None):
    start=time.monotonic()
    with (D/'logs'/('ffi-'+name+'.log')).open('wb') as log:
        rc=subprocess.call(['python3',str(D/'tools/bound.py'),'55',*cmd],cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    receipts.append(dict(step=name,rc=rc,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,command=cmd,cwd=str(cwd)))
    (D/'ffi-build-receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipts,indent=2)+'\n')
    if rc:raise SystemExit(rc)
for arch,target,host,sub in [('x86','x86_64','x86_64-w64-mingw32','x86'),('arm','aarch64','aarch64-w64-mingw32','aarch64')]:
    B=R/(arch+'-build');B.mkdir(exist_ok=True);P=R/(arch+'-prefix');(P/'include').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(P/'lib').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    wrapper=R/('cc-'+arch);wrapper.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexec zig cc -target '+target+'-windows-gnu "$@"\n');wrapper.chmod(0o755)
    env=os.environ.copy();env.update(CC=str(wrapper),AR='zig ar',RANLIB='zig ranlib',CFLAGS='-O2')
    run(arch+'-configure',[str(D/'deps/libffi-3.5.2/configure'),'--build=aarch64-apple-darwin','--host='+host,'--prefix='+str(P),'--disable-docs','--disable-shared','--enable-static','--disable-multi-os-directory'],B,env)
    obj=['src/prep_cif.lo','src/types.lo','src/raw_api.lo','src/java_raw_api.lo','src/closures.lo','src/tramp.lo']+(['src/x86/ffiw64.lo','src/x86/win64.lo'] if arch=='x86' else ['src/aarch64/ffi.lo','src/aarch64/sysv.lo'])
    run(arch+'-objects',['make','-j2',*obj],B,env)
    for p in [B/'include/ffi.h',D/'deps/libffi-3.5.2/src'/sub/'ffitarget.h',B/'fficonfig.h']:shutil.copy2(p,P/'include'/p.name)
    objects=sorted(B.glob('src/*.obj'))+sorted((B/'src'/sub).glob('*.obj'))
    run(arch+'-archive',['zig','ar','rcs',str(P/'lib/libffi.a'),*[str(p) for p in objects]])
    if arch=='arm':
        run('arm-cache',['zig','cc','-target','aarch64-windows-gnu','-O2','-c',str(D/'deps/arm-clear-cache.c'),'-o',str(B/'clear-cache.obj')])
        shutil.copy2(P/'lib/libffi.a',P/'lib/libffi-withcache.a')
        run('arm-adapted-archive',['zig','ar','rcs',str(P/'lib/libffi-withcache.a'),str(B/'clear-cache.obj')])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,time,hashlib,os
D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
receipts=[]
for arch,target,pref,asm,lib in [('x86','x86_64','x86-prefix','x86_64','libffi.a'),('arm','aarch64','arm-prefix','arm64','libffi-withcache.a')]:
    commands=[('compile',['zig','cc','-target',target+'-windows-gnu','-O2','-I'+str(Path(os.environ.get('FFI_PREFIX_BASE',str(D/'deps')))/pref/'include'),'-I'+str(D/'exec/c'),'-c',str(D/'exec/c/libunisacc.c'),'-o',str(D/('libunisacc-'+arch+'.obj'))]),('bridge',['zig','cc','-target',target+'-windows-gnu','-c',str(D/('exec/c/librarycall_windows_'+asm+'.S')),'-o',str(D/('bridge-'+arch+'.obj'))]),('link',['zig','cc','-target',target+'-windows-gnu','-shared',str(D/('libunisacc-'+arch+'.obj')),str(D/('bridge-'+arch+'.obj')),str(Path(os.environ.get('FFI_PREFIX_BASE',str(D/'deps')))/pref/'lib'/lib),'-o',str(D/('libunisacc-'+arch+'.dll'))])]
    for step,cmd in commands:
        begin=time.monotonic()
        with (D/'logs'/(arch+'-'+step+'.log')).open('wb') as log:
            rc=subprocess.call(['python3',str(D/'tools/bound.py'),'55',*cmd],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        receipts.append(dict(target=target,step=step,rc=rc,seconds=time.monotonic()-begin,command=cmd))
        (D/'build-receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipts,indent=2)+'\n')
        if rc:raise SystemExit(rc)
